quote.text: No te dejes apartar de tu deber por cualquier reflexión vana que de ti pueda hacer el mundo necio, porque en tu poder no están sus censuras, y, por consiguiente, no deben importarte nada
quote.author: Epicteto
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • When guiding your children, remember that external judgments or petty criticisms should not deter you from the steadfast pursuit of nurturing their growth and morality.
    • Much like a parent steadfastly tending a garden, stay true to your values and principles despite the noise of misguided opinions, recognizing that the true measure of your duty is reflected in your consistent actions.
  • Leadership:
    • As a leader, focus on your mission and responsibilities, not on the fleeting judgments of others, knowing that the virtue of your leadership is found in your commitment to the greater good.
    • Understand that criticism is often a manifestation of others' limitations, and by remaining anchored in your duty and knowledge, you empower yourself to shape a noble and just path forward.
  • Product Management:
    • In product management, let your decisions be guided by a clear vision and steadfast responsibility, rather than being swayed by unhelpful market chatter or superficial critiques.
    • Recognize that the external noise—be it from competitors or transient trends—does not diminish the value of your purpose; instead, focus on creating meaningful, innovative solutions that reflect your well-considered design and strategy.
